value.message: Town of Oakville's Learn to Swim has Preschool A, Sat 9:00-9:30am, Sept 12 to Nov 28, for 3-5 year olds (no parent in water) - their site says, with Preschool B also running Sat 9:40-10:10am same dates. Fall registration opens Aug 11 at 7am for residents; options browsable online from Aug 4. Fees are set by Council in the current Recreation Guide, not posted yet - I'll keep watching and text you when they are.
